name: Integration Chargebee
description: Integrate Drupal with the Chargebee subscription-billing service.
project_description:
Chargebee is a subscription management and recurring billing solution used by businesses to optimize subscription billing workflow.

 Chargebee module is providing plans with integrated plan page and block. Allow your site visitors to sign up as customers on your Chargebee site and easily manage all card payments using the Hosted Checkout integration.

 Chargebee Documentation: Click here 

 Chargebee Library: composer require chargebee/chargebee-php

 INSTALLATION 

 1. Navigate to Administration > Extend and enable the module.

 2. Go to Administation > Configuration > System > Chargebee

 Path: admin/config/system/chargebee

 3. Add chargebee site name and Api key .

 4. Choose the Plan from the Chargebee plan page.

 Path: admin/config/system/chargebee/plans

 5. Now, user revisit on the chargebee setting page and enable the plan from the chargebee setting page.

 Path: admin/config/system/chargebee

 6. Now, integrate the subscribe plan page anywehre on the site. So, user will access the page.

 Path: /user/{user}/subscribe-plan
